name: HashiCorp Terraform IaC Platform Integration
description: Integration pack for HashiCorp Terraform and Terraform Cloud / Enterprise, providing connectivity to HCL Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution, remote state locking, speculative plan checks, drift detection, and Sentinel policy enforcement.
owner: Infrastructure as Code & Platform Engineering Office

capabilities.name: Infrastructure Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Terraform plan/apply execution, workspace state management, and cloud provider resources.

capabilities.name: Configuration Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Terraform remote state locking, drift detection runs, and variable set definitions.

checklists.name: Terraform Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Terraform Cloud API tokens, remote state backend, and spec plan checks.

items.statement: Terraform Cloud User / Team API Token authenticates REST API calls to workspace endpoints.
Remote State storage uses encrypted backend (S3/GCS/TFC) with state locking enabled.
Speculative terraform plan runs trigger automatically on Pull Requests to validate IaC changes.

reviewGates.name: Terraform IaC Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Infrastructure Lead confirms that Terraform Cloud API tokens and speculative plan checks operate correctly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Terraform integration verify remote state lock enforcement and speculative plan output?

obligationDefinitions.title: Terraform state must be checked for drift from live infrastructure on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: Infrastructure changed outside of Terraform (manual console edits, other tooling) causes the state file to silently diverge from reality; drift must be detected on a recurring cadence, not discovered only when the next apply produces surprising changes.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: A drift-detection plan is run within the declared cadence, with any drift reconciled or explicitly accepted.

requiredEvidence.title: State drift detection report
requiredEvidence.description: Terraform plan output run against live infrastructure to detect drift.
